metadata.note: Of 55,580 websites blocked in India between January 2015 and September 2022 (SFLC.in 'Finding 404', built from RTI replies), 47.5% were blocked by the executive under Section 69A (MeitY + MIB) and 46.8% by court orders, mostly for copyright infringement. This is an aggregate split over the whole period, not a year-by-year series.

rows.label: Executive (Section 69A)
rows.note: MeitY and MIB; orders confidential by rule.

rows.label: Other / unclassified
rows.note: Residual; grounds not specified in disclosures.
